title: Recovering Trace Links In Software Architecture Documentation
summary: Architects document software architecture in textual documentation (SAD) and models (SAM). Trace links between these artifacts improve quality and maintenance, but have so far been created manually. This work develops a taxonomy for Architectural Design Decisions and automated approaches for traceability link recovery between SADs, SAMs, and code. The recovered links enable inconsistency detection, achieving F1-scores of up to 95%, significantly outperforming existing approaches.
